scope: optional USB data restriction while locked
settings_location: Security & privacy > More security & privacy > Device protection

usb.backend: Android USB HAL enableUsbData and AOSP disable-request accounting

modes.2: restrict while locked except when USB debugging is enabled

custom_callbacks.local_calls: same-process calls retained for existing isolated tests

upstream.usage: adapted timer with bounded input, locking, stale callback guard, inhibit and explicit UID checks
adapted keyguard and init-property integration; settings and call/update dependencies use Lineage/AOSP APIs

validation_limits: Host timer tests replace OS timer and shutdown operations.
Host USB tests execute request accounting with a simulated port.
Hardware lock/unlock, calls and OTA interaction require a combined firmware test.
This does not provide GrapheneOS-equivalent boot or USB hardware guarantees.
